body.message:
We would like to confirm that, although the check-in form reflects a monthly arrangement, the agreed contract is for a total stay of three months at a fixed monthly rate of AED 5,500, with no changes or increases during this period. The separate contract for the remaining two months will reflect these agreed terms accordingly.

Please rest assured that for the first three months starting from 23rd April, the rent will remain AED 5,500 per month. It is also completely fine regarding the number of guests as previously confirmed.
Kindly let us know if you need any further clarification.
